meta.distance: Great-circle statute miles from OurAirports coordinates (programmes use their own mileage tables).

seats.rule: Not an alliance benefit: depends on the operating airline.

waitlist.rule: Higher priority on the reservations waitlist, subject to the carrier's fare conditions.

standby.rule: Priority airport standby, where allowed by law; excludes award tickets.

lounge.rule: Any member airline's Business Class lounge showing the Star Alliance Gold sign, in any cabin, with a same-day boarding pass on a Star Alliance-operated flight (or by 05:00 next morning). One guest on the same Star Alliance flight. United MileagePlus Gold members may use United Clubs in the US only when departing on an international Star Alliance flight. Ultra-premium lounges excluded.

checkin.rule: Priority check-in at Star Alliance Gold counters.

baggage.rule: An extra 20 kg or one extra piece, depending on the airline's baggage policy.

seats.rule: Not an alliance benefit: depends on the operating airline.

standby.rule: Priority airport standby; excludes award tickets.

fasttrack.rule: Gold Track for security and immigration, where available.

seats.rule: Preferred or pre-reserved seating, per the operating airline's policy.

waitlist.rule: Priority on waitlists, per the operating airline's policy.

standby.rule: Priority on standby, per the operating airline's policy.

lounge.rule: Business Class and frequent flyer lounges when departing on a flight marketed and operated by a oneworld airline, in any cabin; one guest on a oneworld flight. Not Qantas domestic business lounges. AAdvantage members get none on flights solely within North America.

baggage.rule: Weight system: 15 kg extra. Piece system: one extra bag up to 23 kg on international itineraries (up to two pieces). Not on British Airways Basic fares.

seats.rule: Preferred or pre-reserved seating, per the operating airline's policy.

prioritybag.rule: Priority baggage handling, except on British Airways-operated flights.

lounge.rule: First, Business and frequent flyer lounges when departing on a flight marketed and operated by a oneworld airline, in any cabin; one guest on a oneworld flight. Same North America exception for AAdvantage members. British Airways Concorde and the JFK Chelsea lounge are excluded.

baggage.rule: Weight system: 20 kg extra. Piece system: one extra bag.

seats.rule: Preferred or pre-reserved seating, per the operating airline's policy.

fasttrack.rule: Fast Track or Priority Lane at select airports.

prioritybag.rule: Priority baggage handling, except on British Airways-operated flights.

checkin.rule: SkyPriority check-in and priority bag drop.

baggage.rule: An extra 10 kg, or one extra bag where the piece concept applies.

seats.rule: Priority seating: window or aisle preference, on a best-effort basis.

waitlist.rule: Priority on waitlists for sold-out flights, ahead of all non-Elite customers.

standby.rule: Priority airport standby on SkyTeam-operated flights.

lounge.rule: When travelling on an international flight operated by a SkyTeam airline, or on same-day transfers between two SkyTeam-operated flights. One guest on the same SkyTeam-operated flight.

checkin.rule: SkyPriority check-in, bag drop and transfer desks.

baggage.rule: An extra 20 kg, or one extra bag where the piece concept applies.

seats.rule: Priority seating: window or aisle preference, on a best-effort basis.

waitlist.rule: Priority on waitlists for sold-out flights.

fasttrack.rule: Fast Track at security and immigration, where available. Also: guaranteed full-fare Economy seat on sold-out long-haul flights of 6 hours or more, booked at least 24 hours ahead.

notes: Tier criteria are cut by 25% from 18 March 2026 to 31 March 2027 (Silver, Gold, Platinum; not Emerald).

partner_benefits.label: Alliance status
partner_benefits.value: None. Etihad is in no alliance, so Etihad Guest tiers carry no status on other airlines.

partner_benefits.label: Check-in
partner_benefits.value: Gold and Platinum may use premium business and first check-in counters "on Etihad Airways operated flights and with select partner airlines"; Etihad doesn't name the partners.

partner_benefits.label: Lounges
partner_benefits.value: Only on Etihad-operated flights. Gold and above may use Etihad's lounges worldwide "excluding SkyTeam and oneworld lounges". Codeshares operated by other airlines give no Etihad lounge access.

partner_benefits.label: Earning on partners
partner_benefits.value: Miles on 25+ partners, including Air Canada, American, Air France, KLM and SAS, by distance and booking class. Partner flights earn no Tier Miles and no tier bonus.

partner_benefits.label: Other partner benefits
partner_benefits.value: None published on the partner pages checked (Air Canada, American, Air France, KLM, SAS).

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.qualify: 150,000 Tier Miles and one First or Business flight
